question: Is D14's recorded in_doc AUC (0.7461) comparable to the Stage 1 arms', or was it measured on a different population?
method: D14's frozen checkpoint scored on the byte-identical evaluation set the Stage 1 falsifier used (same builder, same seed 20260803, same 120 batches). Inference only; no training; dev split only.
not_a_revision_of: The Stage 1 verdict. The falsifier was pre-registered against D14's RECORDED number and failed; that stands. This is input to the Stage 2 proposal a rejection requires (proposal Sec.3).
